rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REHABILITATION AND REPAIR OF GABALDON SCHOOLHOUSES NATIONWIDE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Substituted by HB05794

committee_action.remarks: Referred to the DepED for comment.

committee_action.action: Under study by the Technical Working Group(TWG) on 2014-12-01
committee_action.meethigh:
Participants 

1.	Rep. Gwendolyn F. Garcia â€“ TWG Chairperson 
2.	Rep. Victoria G. Noel â€“ Author, House Bill No. 1707
Resource Persons:
3.	Mr. Angel P. Bautista â€“ Director III, Cultural Properties Division, National Museum (NM) 
4.	Engr. Luis Purisima â€“ Physical Facilities Bureau, Department of Education (DepEd)
5.	Mr. Anthony Dignadice â€“ Executive Director, Education Development-Ramon Aboitiz Foundation, Inc. (RAFI)
6.	Arch. Troy Elizaga â€“ University of San Carlos College of Architecture and Fine Arts â€“Conservation and Heritage Research Institute, Cebu City
7.	Atty. Trixie Angeles â€“ Legal Counsel, National Commission for Culture and the Arts 
8.	Mr. Morris Lim -  National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA)
Secretariat:
9.	Ms. Marilou F. De Guzman 
10.	Mr. Nemesio O. Malatamban III 
11.	Ms. Myrna D. Dolor
12.	Ms. Nora Emilia R. Bakunawa
13.	Ms. Estela V. Sevilla
14.	Ms. Eleanor P. Velasco 


Discussion Proper

â€¢	Mr. Dignadice provided a PowerPoint presentation about the Gabaldon School buildings; its historical accounts, the different plans and designs it has depending on school population and the preservation initiatives that the RAFI has undertaken together with the Provincial Capitol of Cebu, DepEd  and local government unit where the Gabaldon school is located, by virtue of a Memorandum of Agreement.  He said that the project commenced in 2007 and is expected to finish in 2016 covering 30 Gabaldon schools.
â€¢	Mr. Bautista of the NM suggested the inclusion of Spanish colonial buildings/structures that are being used as academic venues which may be located within church, civic or government grounds that are considered important cultural properties.
â€¢	Engr. Purisima of DepEd requested the deletion of Physical Facilities and Schools Engineering Division (PSFED) because under the Rationalization Plan of the DepEd, its function is already subsumed under another office.  He then suggested to just indicate DepEd as the office in authority overseeing the conservation obligations over Gabaldon structures.
â€¢	Atty. Angeles of the NCCA suggested the inclusion of a proviso indicating the requirement to secure a permit from the NCCA prior to any modification, alteration, demolition or relocation of any Gabaldon school house.  
â€¢	Chair Garcia highlighted the need to address the concern of Rep. Romulo, during the mother committee meeting, to consider areas that lack space and may need to make any modification, alteration, demolition or relocation to a Gabaldon school.  She then suggested to delete â€œNational Capital Regionâ€� and use a more generic reference as it may not be just in the NCR that the problem of space is prevalent but also in other highly urbanized or key cities of the country.
â€¢	Engr. Purisima appealed to soften the penalty meted to school heads who may fail to report any damage to a Gabaldon school to render an administrative liability subject to Civil Service rules rather than the impose a two hundred thousand pesos fine and/or imprisonment of not less than ten years.
â€¢	Chair Garcia also suggested the inclusion of a provision to recognize private participation and incentives to donations.

Agreements Made

1)	On Section 4, delete Physical Facilities and Schools Engineering Division (PSFED) and mandate the DepEd and the NCCA to make an inventory and assessment of all Gabaldon schoolhouses all over the country;  Use the word â€œareasâ€� instead of â€œNational Capital Regionâ€� and include a proviso indicating the requirement to secure a permit from the NCCA prior to any modification, alteration, demolition or relocation of any Gabaldon school
2)	Refine Section 6 (Penalties), subject to style, to reckon with the provisions of Section 4 (Conservation of Gabaldon Schoolhouses)
3)	Insert a provision for Private Participation and Incentives for Donations

committee_action.action: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2015-02-03
committee_action.meethigh:
A draft substitute bill was used as the working draft.  The TWG agreed on the following:

1)	On Section 4

â€¢	Delete Physical Facilities and Schools Engineering Division (PSFED) and mandate the Department of Education and the National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA) to make an inventory and assessment of all Gabaldon schoolhouses all over the country
â€¢	Include a proviso indicating the requirement to secure a permit from the NCCA prior to any modification, alteration, demolition or relocation of a Gabaldon school

2)	On Section 6

â€¢	Impose an administrative liability to school heads who fail to report any damage or alteration to a Gabaldon structure subject to Civil Service Rules rather than two hundred thousand pesos fine and/or imprisonment of not less than ten years
â€¢	Refine the provision to reckon with the provisions of Section 4 (Conservation of Gabaldon Schoolhouses)

3)	Insert a provision for Private Participation and Incentives for Donations 
4)	Reps. Gwendolyn Garcia and Sony P. Collantes manifested co-authorship of the bill
